prompt: A cinematic editorial portrait of a Chanel-inspired female knight featured on the cover of VOGUE. She wears intricately engraved silver armor layered over a quilted black-and-white tweed undersuit, with a high neckline and camellia-embossed shoulder plates. A double-C motif is subtly engraved on the chestplate and belt clasp. Her cape, flowing behind her, features a monochrome camellia pattern lining and is pinned with a pearl brooch. She stands tall and poised, holding a slender rapier with a pearl-encrusted guard, her left foot grounded and weight balanced evenly. The background is a neutral-toned studio wall with soft gradients and generous empty space around her figure. From head to toe and waist-up dual composition, VOGUE logo overlays the top frame. Hyper-realistic, 8K quality, soft studio lighting that makes the skin appear fair and clean. --ar 9:16 --stylize 250.5 --v 7
